cards.subject: A city that worked
lines: A multi-level machine-city, lost after a five-year secret war against troggs tunnelling up from underneath it.
Read the wing names as you fight through them — Dormitory, Launch Bay, Workshop, Engineering Labs. Every one is named for what it used to do.

cards.subject: The only Alliance race with no city
cards.tag: Which is why this is a dungeon
lines: New gnomes start in dwarf territory in Dun Morogh, and the High Tinker rules from a borrowed district of Ironforge.
There is a front door in the snow with a train station attached — a city that expected commuters.
This is the home they lost, and you are farming it.

cards.subject: The leper gnomes
lines: They are the gnomes who did not get out — mutated and driven mad by their own government's gas, then recruited by the gnome who released it.
Thermaplugg was caught in it too.
He is a leper gnome calling himself king of the gnomes.

cards.subject: Sicco
lines: Mekkatorque thought him one of the brightest gnomes alive, but too impatient, sloppy and goblin-esque — about the worst thing one gnome can say about another.
His first name is presumably a wordplay on sicko.
They were friends from youth.

cards.subject: There is a post box in here
lines: An engineering vendor, holdout medics and technicians, and a mailbox — inside the instance.
A shop and a post box in the middle of a dungeon is close to unique.
Somebody is still holding an office in a dead city.

cards.subject: The Sparklematic 5200
lines: Trash in here drops filthy junk, and there are machines in the Clean Zone that will wash it for you and hand back whatever was underneath.
A coin-operated laundromat for loot, in an irradiated ruin.

cards.subject: Matrix Punchograph 3005
lines: A through E, bolted in different parts of the city. Each eats one punch card and prints the next colour: white, yellow, blue, red, prismatic.
The chain physically drags you through the entire dungeon.
Removed in Cataclysm.

cards.subject: Viscous Fallout
cards.tag: The thing that killed the city, with a body
lines: An early mini-boss that is, literally, the leaked radiation walking around as a puddle.
It drops the Hydrocane, which breathes underwater forever.
People kept that thing in their bags for another thirty levels.

cards.subject: Crowd Pummeler 9-60
lines: Oglethorpe Obnoticus designed an unbeatable robot. Thermaplugg took the blueprints and built this oversized version, and Obnoticus was banished for it.
Unjustly.
He is alive and well in Booty Bay, and you can go and stand in front of him.

cards.subject: Dark Iron Ambassador
lines: A rare elite with no proper name, no quest and no dialogue.
The reading nobody has ever confirmed: he is the envoy between Thermaplugg and the Dark Iron clan.
A diplomat left standing in a gnome city, unexplained for twenty years.

cards.subject: Mekgineer Thermaplugg
lines: He fights out of a cauldron-shaped prototype suit, in the room where the council of gnome engineers used to meet.
Bomb assemblies on the walls keep spitting walking bombs at random people until somebody runs over and hits the red switch on the side.
"Explosions! MORE explosions! I've got to have more explosions!"

cards.subject: They took it back
lines: In here, this dungeon is the only place Thermaplugg exists and killing him is the end of him.
Blizzard later decided every group that ever beat him had actually destroyed a clever facsimile, so that he could come back.
Whatever you do down there was retroactively undone.
